newsitem.title: UK: EMI gives up gains made in prior session.
newsitem.headline: EMI gives up gains made in prior session.

text.p: Shares in leading British music publisher EMI Group Plc were marked down on Wednesday in a reaction to sharp gains made the previous session, dealers said.

EMI shares were down 25.5 pence, or 2.05 percent, to 1118.5p by 1120 GMT in volume of 1.3 million while the FTSE-100 index was 1.5 points, or 0.03 percent, higher at 4,434.7. EMI gained 25p on Tuesday.
"There's no particular news in the stock which was the same case yesterday when it was marked up" said a marketmaker at a British bank.
EMI has long been regarded as a takeover target.
Bid speculation for EMI intensified last summer when the group demerged from its parent Thorn EMI which split up its music and rental businesses.
